help.whatsapp: WhatsApp support available Monday to Saturday, 8am to 6pm

onboardClient.q: How do I onboard a new client?
onboardClient.a: Go to "Onboard Clients" in the menu, choose whether it's a listener, an artist, or an advertiser, fill in their information, select a subscription plan, and collect payment if needed.

paymentMethods.q: What payment methods can I accept?
paymentMethods.a: You can record payments by cash, Mobile Money, bank transfer, or card when setting up a subscription for a client.

commission.a: You earn a 10% commission on every paid subscription you help set up. Check your earnings on the Transactions page.

existingAccount.q: What if a client already has an account?
existingAccount.a: Search for them in "My Clients". If they don't appear, contact Asrapa support to link an existing account to your agent profile.

role.title: Your role as an Asrapa agent
role.description: Many people in your community may not be comfortable signing up and subscribing on their own. Use this portal to onboard them, collect payments, and earn a commission on every subscription you help set up.
